subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: Should OpenClaw accept the protected product direction of replacing the iPhone tab bar and Control hub with this sidebar-first navigation shell after the Settings-edge inconsistency is corrected?
rationale: The patch changes the primary navigation model, destination discoverability, and persisted sidebar preferences across the iOS app; code review can identify defects but cannot independently choose the permanent product direction.

options.title: Sponsor the sidebar shell after repair
options.body: Keep the sidebar-first design, move the Settings reveal control to the leading edge, and confirm restored-session behavior on the current head before merge.

options.title: Narrow the redesign
options.body: Retain only the agreed navigation and session-switching portions, deferring dashboard or parity additions to smaller follow-up PRs.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the sidebar shell after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the sidebar-first design, move the Settings reveal control to the leading edge, and confirm restored-session behavior on the current head before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history and related navigation-direction issue tie this contributor directly to the proposed shell and its intended web parity.
